subject: New feature: automatic initialisation of attributes

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: New feature: automatic initialisation of attributes
parts:
Hi all,

The next release (scheduled for this month) will add a new argument to
set_attribute and set_global to easily implement counters and indexes
without initialisation boilerplate. E.g.:

t <- trajectory() %>%
set_global("index", 1, mod="+") %>%
...

will now automatically start at index=0, but it is configurable with
the "init" argument.

Regards,
Iñaki
